verses.1: Alleluia. I have loved: therefore, the Lord will heed the voice of my prayer.
verses.2: For he has inclined his ear to me. And in my days, I will call upon him.
verses.3: The sorrows of death have surrounded me, and the perils of Hell have found me. I have found tribulation and sorrow.
verses.4: And so, I called upon the name of the Lord. O Lord, free my soul.
verses.5: Merciful is the Lord, and just. And our God is compassionate.
verses.6: The Lord is the keeper of little ones. I was humbled, and he freed me.
verses.7: Turn again, my soul, to your rest. For the Lord has done good to you.
verses.8: For he has rescued my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from slipping.
verses.9: I will please the Lord in the land of the living. [ Psalm 115 ] (116B)
